args.note: For amm 316L, E_s=193 GPa and nu_s=0.30, so K_s=E_s/[3(1-2nu_s)]=160.8333 GPa. The Voigt energy upper bound for any void/solid periodic cell is K_eff <= relative_density*K_s. At relative density <=0.35, K_eff <=56.2917 GPa, below the required 67.6 GPa. This proves infeasibility across all allowed families, independent of cell size. A necessary (not sufficient) relative density for 67.6 GPa is at least 0.4203109. LPBF manufacturability is outside the evaluated scope.
